factor_definitions.MKT_RF: Excess market return from the Fama/French U.S. daily factor file.
factor_definitions.MOM: Momentum factor from the separate U.S. daily momentum file.

date_convention: daily trading dates in ISO YYYY-MM-DD after canonical conversion

parser_behavior.header_detection: explicit match on the expected daily header row
parser_behavior.footer_termination: stop at the first copyright/footer line after data begins
parser_behavior.sentinel_handling: reject any observed sentinel token rather than preserve it

missing_sentinel_behavior_observed.Fama/French 5 Factors [Daily]: No sentinel values observed in the parsed daily archive.
missing_sentinel_behavior_observed.Momentum Factor (Mom) [Daily]: No sentinel values observed in the parsed daily archive.

known_multi_asset_limitation: Equity factors are intentionally incomplete for the multi-asset PortfolioLab sleeve.
